title: Unquoted variable in rm command
description: rm -rf $DEPLOY_DIR/previous/* without quotes is vulnerable to word splitting and glob expansion.

title: Command injection via eval
description: eval on file contents allows arbitrary command execution if the config file is attacker-controlled or writable.

title: Pipe-to-bash from HTTP URL
description: curl | bash executes remote code without verification over plain HTTP. MITM or server compromise leads to RCE.

title: Predictable temporary file path
description: Using /tmp/deploy-$$ is predictable. Use mktemp instead to avoid symlink attacks.

title: chmod 777 on web directory
description: chmod 777 grants world-writable permissions to the web root, allowing any user to modify served files.
